      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes `TxIndex::FindTx` interface and implementation in `src/index/txindex.cpp` and `src/index/txindex.h` to return `util::Expected` on read failures.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Propagates I/O and deserialization errors out of `TxIndex::FindTx` instead of collapsing them to not-found. While useful for distinguishing index lookup corruption from missing transactions, it addresses an uncommon disk error condition without altering the index data structure or synchronization."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and updates `getrawtransaction`, `gettxoutproof`, `rest_tx`, and `ProcessPSBT` in `src/rpc/` and `src/rest.cpp`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents RPC and REST endpoints from falsely reporting that a transaction does not exist when an underlying disk read fails. Throwing an internal error on disk or deserialization failure fixes misleading responses that could cause downstream services to misinterpret node I/O corruption, though it affects an uncommon failure mode."

categories.evidence: Changes `TxIndex::FindTx` interface and implementation in `src/index/txindex.cpp` and `src/index/txindex.h` to return `util::Expected` on read failures.
categories.rationale: Propagates I/O and deserialization errors out of `TxIndex::FindTx` instead of collapsing them to not-found. While useful for distinguishing index lookup corruption from missing transactions, it addresses an uncommon disk error condition without altering the index data structure or synchronization.

Throwing an internal error on disk or deserialization failure fixes misleading responses that could cause downstream services to misinterpret node I/O corruption, though it affects an uncommon failure mode.
